mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at 70 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you are a night owl, keep an eye out for the International Space Station at 4:19 AM as it passes from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east, reaching halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has installed a public art piece called Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This sculpture was created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements.

Today, you can enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market, drop-in yoga, live music at Paddy Macs, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, check out trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus and live music this Thursday at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable incident on August 30, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and a bicyclist on East Verona Avenue. Thankfully, the cyclist was not injured and the driver was cited.
Today's flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 46 minutes, so be sure to head over before they shut their doors for the night.
